proposal: Curve in the DS-101 revision; limiter in the TCS.
question: ER-03.03 (TQ-017 with the Owner) requires operation on gas at a pressure-limited load between 40 and 45 barg at TP-G1. With the EPC gas station losses of 4.7 bar, IF-01 sees 35.3 barg at 40 barg TP-G1. Please give the GT load versus IF-01 pressure curve below 36.5 barg for the load limiter.
response: GT load limit versus fuel gas pressure at IF-01 (natural gas, base-load fuel temperature): 36.5 barg 100 %, 35.0 barg 92 %, 34.0 barg 85 %, 31.5 barg 65 %, 29.0 barg 45 % (minimum for DLN operation). At 35.3 barg the GT carries about 94 % load - better than the 60 % assumed in ER-03.03.
subject: GT load versus fuel gas pressure at IF-01
